purpose: Clover-inspired brand proposals for review, not production app assets.
commonPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished landscape 1536x1024 brand concept board for a private period and perimenopause journal. The owner wants to honor a person named Clover. The central brand emblem MUST be a FOUR-LEAF CLOVER with exactly FOUR clearly distinguishable leaves around a center and one short gently curved stem. It must immediately read as a four-leaf clover, not a three-leaf shamrock, flower, butterfly or arbitrary petals. Original simple flat vector-friendly mark, strong silhouette, generous negative space, broad shapes that work at small icon sizes. Soft, feminine, grown-up, readable, clean. No cartoon mascot, luck/gambling imagery, sparkles, coins, rainbows, medical symbols, literal blood drops, gradients, tiny veins, fine filigree or 3D effects. Do not imitate any existing brand. Composition: upper left large elegant legible contemporary serif wordmark with exact brand name. Below it the exact tagline 'Your cycle. Your space.' and descriptor 'Private cycle journal'. Lower left show a large rounded-square launcher icon and a smaller circular masked rendering; both contain the same clover emblem only, without text. Beneath them four palette swatches. At right two slim front-facing Android phone silhouettes side by side showing light and dark native launch screens, labeled outside the phones 'Light launch' and 'Dark launch'. Inside each phone show ONLY a modest centered clover emblem on a solid background. No wordmark, slogan, loading indicator, buttons, artwork, UI or personal data inside either phone. Reuse exactly the same four-leaf silhouette in every rendering. Footer text exactly 'Brand concept / for review'. Flat editorial presentation, spacious alignment, crisp high-contrast typography. Only the specified words; no extra text.

directions.prompt: Brand name exactly 'Cloverelle' (C-l-o-v-e-r-e-l-l-e). Color direction: warm plum #604054, petal rose #E4BACB, ivory #FBF7F5, dark plum #261F28. Four gently heart-shaped clover leaves arranged diagonally, a small open center and short curved stem. Each of the four leaves has a subtle heart notch and broad rounded lobes; count four complete leaves, not eight separate petals. The whole mark tilts slightly for a natural personal character. On the plum launcher tile, three leaves and stem are ivory and one leaf is petal rose. Light launch: three plum leaves and stem, one muted rose leaf on ivory. Dark launch: three ivory leaves and stem, one rose leaf on dark plum. Ivory board background and large dark-plum serif wordmark. An affectionate feminine four-leaf-clover identity with clear visual continuity to the existing plum app palette.

Brand name exactly 'Clovermere' (C-l-o-v-e-r-m-e-r-e). Color direction: deep sage #3F6254, pale sage #C7D9CB, warm cream #FAF8F1, dark forest #1F2C26. Four broad softly rounded clover leaves with subtle shallow outer notches, arranged on diagonals around a small clean center, joined to a short sturdy curved stem. Less heart-shaped than a romantic clover: calm botanical geometry with an elegant slightly asymmetric silhouette. The four-leaf count must be obvious. On the deep-sage launcher tile, three leaves and stem are warm cream and one leaf is pale sage. Light launch: three deep-sage leaves and stem, one medium sage leaf on cream. Dark launch: three cream leaves and stem, one pale-sage leaf on dark forest. Cream board background and large deep-sage serif wordmark. A quietly feminine botanical identity with a memorable simple four-leaf-clover silhouette.
